reasons: orchestrator.py:40-57 decision path: obs['text']['long_term_context'] -> Chart.observe (tools/chart.py:29-41 parses only the cursor, Dlvl, the map: block and the adjacency prose from the observation text) -> BFS plan -> prompt block -> ONE client.generate per step -> extract_action. No env, oracle, full_state, seed or task-id access anywhere.

tools/action_io.py: the legal set is parsed from the agent's own system prompt; the reply is projected onto it whole-word, with a veto for blocked/deadly directions and a fallback to the BFS first hop. This is legitimate output filtering built from observed state, not hardcoding.
tools/prompting.py only composes the naive transcript + AGENT.md/memory.md priors + the chart table. It never touches the scorer, the summary files or env.step.

Traces agree with the code: the CSV Reasoning column records route=<kind>:<hop>@<dist> picked=<action>; input_tokens scale with num_steps (e.g. Quest-Easy 11 steps/25.6k tokens, Boxoban 100 steps/630k tokens), so the model is really called every step; the episode returns are ordinary (mostly 0 or negative), with no sign of scorer manipulation or banked partial scores.
